Keep your camera feeds and AI processing under your control.

Viseron is a self-hosted, local-only NVR and AI computer vision platform with object detection, motion detection, face recognition, and more.

Run it with Docker and manage your setup through a web interface without relying on cloud processing.

More details:
https://digitalescapetools.com/tools/tool.html?id=viseron
